summary: Frontend-only retest of the iteration_4 fixes (Playwright 400x860 on the preview URL + a temporary jest check of perkOffer/mixiPassive/normalizeMeta, since deleted). All 5 fixes PASS. (1) Mixi Max role passive: an attacker donor (Mark Kruger, role A, real W14 anomaly) shows '+10% ATK' in the anomaly intro, in reward-notice and in run.mixi.label. A goalkeeper donor (cameo injected as mark:base, role P) shows '+12% HP massimi' in the intro, the notice and the TeamScreen <uid>-mixi-info ('Mixi Max · aura di Mark Evans (+12% HP massimi)'). Unit check: torch A -> +10% ATK, nathan/jack D -> +10% DIF. (2) HP with Ray Dark I: stored team 253/373/290 (Jack has Mixi +12% HP too). In battle Nathan shows 215/215 (=253*0.85). After an undamaged win the stored HP is back to 253/373/290. A second battle (W15 -> W17) gives the same result, so there is no drain or stacking. (3) Importing the save code {v:1, meta:{teamSpirit:5}, run:null} gives no pageerror: the title renders, meta is normalized (unlocked/records/collection defaults) and the Perks screen shows a balance of 5. (4) perkOffer: with tiro active, inazumabreak is never offered (50 draws). With inazumabreak active, tiro and scatto are never offered. (5) The cursed offer card reads 'Patto di Ray Dark I / Maledetto' (once). The consequence swap hint reads 'Hai già Jude Sharp (Royal): puoi passare a questa versione...' with no extra parentheses. hud-perk-banner is position:absolute and the overworld-map y stays at 159 before and after opening it (overlay).

issues: Over-blocking side effect: when one fusion component is active (e.g. Tiro Potente), the blocked set also contains the other component (Scatto Bruciante), because flatMap adds all requires. A player with Tiro active is never offered Scatto, even though they stack legitimately and only the fusion should be excluded. Verified: with tiro active and scatto III unlocked, the offer was always [muro, vento] + raydark. Suggested change: block the fusion if any component is active, and block the components only if the fusion is active.

action_items: Optional/minor: in perkOffer only exclude the fusion when a component is active and the components when the fusion is active. Do not exclude sibling components of each other.
critical_code_review_comments: perks.js perkOffer: the blocked set is too wide (see design issue).
BattleScreen settleHp converts battle HP back correctly with p.hp*clean.maxHp/p.maxHp and clamps to [1, clean.maxHp]. OK.
